## Interfaces

se_workflow/tier2.py starts detached tmux full suite, records integration check-run, extends phase gate and fix clustering; execute-phase documents reviewer→tier-2→gate→merge; dashboard model/tasks show t2 run|ok@SHA|fail@SHA from subject <phase>-tier2; verify_budget/README keep per-task scoped.

## Assumptions

Subject convention <phase>-tier2 and evidence_kind integration shared by engine and dashboard; dirty-only tier-2 refused like check policy; tmux available in dogfood.

## Invariants

Per-task verify stays scoped; tier-2 required at head before merge; failures become fix tasks under retry budget — held by skill text, tests, and gate helper.

## Conflicts

none
